mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market overheating that accelerates inflation and triggers monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST declines during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (2017 base) for two consecutive months, manufacturing contraction reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) indicate dual shock of monetary tightening and labor market weakness that accelerates economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing growth that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO increases during early-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
